messages:
elaine: Quick poll: For the Usage dashboard when scoped to an org, should the top spend card show a compact summary (totals + small trend) or the full project line-items by default? Trying to reduce vertical length but keep key actions visible. (mock attached)

noah: lean towards compact summary. Execs and finance teams just want totals and invoice access. We can surface per-project rows behind an expansion control.

rui: Compact is fine but the download invoice CSV needs to be super visible. If it's hidden behind expand, it'll cause support tickets. Maybe an inline download button next to the total.

maya: inline CTA makes sense on wider viewports. On phones we should collapse it into the kebab menu. Also prefer the label: "Download invoice (PDF)" + small date string.

elaine: Agreed. Also thinking about token breakdown labels: currently we use P / C abbreviations. Can we switch to full words visually, but show abbreviations in tight table mode? Accessibility requires full readable labels.

noah: yes, full words for screen readers and default view. In condensed rows we can show abbreviated labels with tooltip showing full term.

samira: Accessibility reminder: any inline download needs descriptive aria-label like "Download invoice for March 2026, $12,345" and rel=noopener on the link. Focus order should be natural (total -> download -> expand).

rui: Implementation detail: the micro-chart option is interesting. We could render a tiny stacked bar inside the card showing project proportions. Hover (desktop) or tap (mobile) reveals project names. But need keyboard focusable segments.

noah: if we use stacked micro-chart, ensure contrast and 4px minimum tap target for accessibility. Also add text fallback showing top 2 project names for very narrow widths.

elaine: Good point. What about showing fine-tune/ft costs? Most orgs won't have them. Suggest hiding fine-tune line unless it's non-zero and adding a small "+ ft" badge when present.

samira: Copy nit: change header from "Token breakdown" to "Usage details" ? It might read clearer across billing and usage contexts.

maya: I prefer "Token usage" personally. Leaning to that since it's consistent with other console language.

noah: We should A/B both labels in the experiment. Put a toggle in the settings for opt-in to project-first default (for DA/Platform teams who onboard many projects).

r ui: Billing API update: billing-bot says CSV endpoint now returns invoice.download_url and invoice.run_meta. We can wire the desktop button directly to download_url and show a small flyout with run id.

elaine: Action items: 1) produce two Figma frames: compact card (inline download on wide screens) and expanded list default for project-first experiment, 2) ensure ARIA and keyboard for micro-chart, 3) add responsive rule: >= 960px show inline download; < 960px move to kebab. I'll post frames later today.

maya: thanks! I'll add copy suggestions for the button and tooltip texts.

noah: ping me when frames are up, happy to review spacing/visual weight.

billing-bot: "Export CSV queued (job id: b12f). Notification will be sent when ready."
